meta.note: Mock data. Dates cover 2026-09-13 to 2026-10-04. e01-e29 are fully mock; e30+ are mock events placed at real venues from scoop-venues-bkk.json (location, phone, website, nearest station © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL) - venue.venue_id links back to that file and venue.google_maps_url opens a Google Maps search for the venue. Event titles, times, prices and seats are invented.
meta.images_note: image_path is a 640px copy in assets/events/ served by the bot at /assets; image_url is the original Wikimedia Commons thumbnail. Every photo is CC BY / CC BY-SA / CC0 / public domain - image_credit and image_source give the author and licence page.
